dedupe_keys.name: 種類別道路延長及ひ面積 roads bridges and tunnels series on tokyo open data catalog

description: 種類別道路延長及び面積 [roads, bridges and tunnels] (series on Tokyo Open Data Catalog) is a series of datasets listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 調布市. 【調布市】. Coverage: 調布市. The portal lists 7 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 調布市. It offers 1 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2026-05-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
